item.text: {"iteration":5,"pcvs":[{"name":"scheduled_requests","expression":"len(scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens)","rationale":"Captures per-request processing."},{"name":"finishing_requests","expression":"len([r for r in self.running if r.num_output_tokens + 1 >= r.max_tokens])","rationale":"Captures per-request completion and resource release."},{"name":"new_requests","expression":"len(scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs)","rationale":"Captures prefill completion work."},{"name":"cleanup_and_small_prefill","expression":"2 * any(r.num_output_tokens + 1 >= r.max_tokens for r in self.running) + (3 * max(0, 3 - len(scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs)) if scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs else 0)","rationale":"Combines the fixed cost of entering stopped-request queue cleanup with the observed excess cost of small prefill batches."}],"hypothesis":"Cleanup has a fixed branch cost in addition to its per-finishing-request cost. The previous model omitted this distinction, especially visible in the two-request decode with no finishes. Combining this branch indicator with the small-prefill term tests both effects within four expressions."}
